name: deepfake-screener
description: Runs the backend API and the frontend app together.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend run models:download
scripts.start: npm run build && npm --prefix backend start
